# P4: Circuit Math — Grading Rubric

| Criterion | Poor | Good | Excellent | Weight |
|-----------|------|------|-----------|--------|
| **Abstract & Description** | Missing, vague, or covers only one circuit | Mentions both circuits; description is thin | Describes both the differentiator and the LPF experiment | 10% |
| **Circuit Schematic, Background and Discussion** | No schematics, no photos, and no description of either circuit | One circuit fully documented, or both described but design rationale absent | Schematic for each circuit; component values stated; design choices explained (RC = 0.5ms for differentiator, f_c = 1kHz and DC gain = 2 for LPF) | 20% |
| **Circuit Function** | No evidence that either circuit was exercised | Evidence for at least one circuit (scope trace OR simulation plot) | Scope trace showing triangle input and differentiated output for the differentiator AND simulation frequency-response plot for the LPF | 40% |
| **Results (including stats exercises)** | No quantitative validation; stats exercises absent or not seriously attempted | Quantitative analysis attempted but incomplete, or one stats exercise missing | Differentiator V_out validated quantitatively (RC × dV/dt compared to scope); LPF cutoff confirmed from simulation; all three stats exercises seriously attempted | 20% |
| **Conclusion** | Missing or vague with no numerical results | Conclusion present but thin — reflection or one circuit missing | States key measured/validated results for both circuits; includes brief reflection | 10% |
